title: The Name of the Dark Horse
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji took the note, an aged gaze from the distant tower pierced through the crowd, falling upon his back—that was the unique aura of the Third Elder of the Tianqing Sect.

text.content: The cold snort echoed like clashing cold iron through the Martial Arena. Han Lie stood with arms crossed, the Xuanwu patterns embroidered on his black training attire rippled subtly in the sunlight—a mark only core disciples of the Xuanwu Sect possessed. His stare at Chen Ji was like watching a fox finally reveal its tail.

dialogue.content: Trash? Hmph, it seems this one was mistaken.

text.content: The surrounding Outer Disciples hastily stepped aside, as if afraid to be caught in Han Lie's imposing aura. Chen Ji, however, acted as if he heard nothing, calmly bending to pick up the scattered spirit stones from the ground, his movements unhurried as if defeating Zhao Yuan moments ago was merely an insignificant sparring match.

dialogue.content: Han Shixiong is too kind. This junior merely got lucky, meeting Brother Zhao when he was physically exhausted.

text.content: These words, landing in Han Lie's ears, were more stinging than mockery. Luck? Physical exhaustion? He clearly saw Zhao Yuan have three ribs broken by that single palm! A sudden low cry rang out from the crowd: "The second match is starting! The opponent is... Zhou Ting! Ranked seventh among Outer Disciple seed candidates!"

choice.prompt: Zhou Ting, ranked seventh among Outer Disciple seed candidates, wielded the Thundering Sword Style with fierce precision. Facing such a formidable opponent, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to predict moves, end the battle within three exchanges, letting everyone see the gap
choices.visible_reward: Reputation greatly increased, shocking the entire arena
choices.risk_hint: Exposing too much strength will attract attention from higher levels

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment warmed slightly. Three breaths later, a flash of understanding crossed Chen Ji's eyes. Zhou Ting's sword trajectory, force nodes, points of weakness—everything was under his control. The corner of his mouth lifted slightly as his figure surged forward.

choices.description: Pretend to barely win, letting everyone think it was just luck, continue playing the pig eating the tiger
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the废物 persona, reduce attention
choices.risk_hint: Might flip in the gutter if control is lost

text.content: Chen Ji deliberately slowed by half a beat, forcing Zhou Ting's Thundering Sword to drive him backward repeatedly. Sword light grazed past his ear, slicing off a few strands of hair. A gasp erupted from the stands, and Su Qingyao's brush tip paused slightly.

dialogue.content: So... so fast! What a sword!

choices.text: Retreat to advance, enrage the opponent
choices.description: Verbally provoke Zhou Ting, making him reveal weaknesses in anger
choices.visible_reward: Weaken opponent's Combat Power without consuming Heavenly Fate
choices.risk_hint: If the opponent doesn't take the bait, you'll fall into a passive situation

text.content: Chen Ji sidestepped the sword edge, then suddenly laughed lightly: "Thundering Sword Style? This junior remembers... this move seems to have an old flaw in its finishing form?" Zhou Ting's face changed abruptly, and his sword technique indeed faltered.

dialogue.content: Oh? It seems Brother Zhou knows as well.

text.content: Regardless of which strategy was chosen, the battle's outcome was毫无悬念. Chen Ji's palm wind surged toward Zhou Ting like a tide, the seemingly fierce Thundering Sword Style was riddled with openings in his eyes. "Bang!", Zhou Ting was sent staggering back ten steps, kneeling to the ground clutching his wrist, eyes filled with disbelief.

dialogue.content: Three moves... Zhou Ting only lasted three moves!

text.content: The Outer Disciples exchanged glances, the previous mockery of Chen Ji vanished completely, replaced by whispered discussions. "Who is this person?" "Seems to be that servant disciple..." "Impossible! How could a servant disciple have such strength!" In the shadows at the back of the crowd, Su Qingyao closed the Jade Slip in her hand, a sharp light flickering in her eyes.

The third match followed immediately, with the opponent being Sun Hao, ranked fourth among Outer Disciple seeds. However, the moment Chen Ji stepped onto the Arena Platform, he acutely sensed a幽cold gaze piercing through the crowd, falling upon him. That aura... did not belong to the Tianqing Sect.

choice.prompt: That gaze came from a woman with a black纱covering her face, her temperament completely out of place with those around her. How to deal with this unexpected attention?

choices.text: Take the initiative to nod, expressing goodwill
choices.description: Respond with martial world etiquette, displaying poised bearing
choices.visible_cost: Might be misunderstood as associating with the Demonic Path
choices.risk_hint: Sect Elders present might take notice

text.content: Chen Ji neither humbly nor haughtily gave a slight nod. The black纱woman seemed startled, then the corner of her lips curved into an amused arc. This scene, falling in Su Qingyao's eyes, made her fingers gripping the brush tighten slightly.

choices.description: Pretend not to see, focus on the battle at hand
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to take the initiative
choices.visible_reward: Not expose attention toward the mysterious figure
choices.risk_hint: Might make the other party think you're impolite

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, placing full attention on Sun Hao. However, that gaze grew increasingly intense, like burning a hole in his back.

choices.text: Counter with a gaze, testing depths
choices.description: Directly meet her gaze, testing her reaction
choices.visible_reward: Gain information about the other party's true attitude
choices.risk_hint: A master might analyze your strength from this

text.content: In the moment their four eyes met, Chen Ji felt a幽cold chill invade his mind. Yet his expression remained unchanged, merely raising one eyebrow slightly. The woman laughed lightly and was the first to look away.

Sun Hao's strength was indeed impressive; with玄气 protection he actually engaged Chen Ji in a prolonged fight for over a dozen moves. However, Chen Ji had long seen through his true nature through the Tianji Record's foresight—appearing strong but actually weak, with暗伤 in his seventh stage玄气. When Sun Hao used his trump card, the "Rock-Crushing Fist," Chen Ji's body flashed, his palm blade accurately cutting the meridian on his right shoulder.

dialogue.content: Brother Sun's Rock-Crushing Fist has sufficient power, but lacks follow-through.

text.content: Sun Hao's right arm hung limply, the intense pain making his face pale. Three battles, three victories! The Outer Court Training Grounds erupted completely. "Dark horse! An absolute super dark horse!" "What happened to that废物 servant disciple!" "I said early on he wasn't simple!" The heated discussions surged like waves, yet Chen Ji walked down from the Arena Platform with a平静 expression, as if all this was within expectation.

At the teahouse beside the Martial Arena, Su Qingyao tucked the Jade Slip into her sleeve, her brow furrowed slightly. "Three battles, three distinctly different styles... What is he hiding?" The old servant beside her said quietly: "Miss, should this old servant investigate this person?" Su Qingyao shook her head: "Not yet. The more he wants to hide, the more I want to see... just how deep he can hide."

dialogue.content: Record: Palm technique path unclear, depth of玄气 strength questionable, extremely high battle intelligence but deliberately suppressed. Key observation subject number three.

text.content: At this moment, a black figure silently approached Chen Ji. It was precisely that woman with the black纱covering her face. She walked to Chen Ji's side, her voice pressed extremely low, carrying a hoarse magnetism.

dialogue.content: "Young Master Chen, might we speak privately?"

text.content: Chen Ji's heart stirred, but he did not immediately agree. He studied the woman before him—beneath the black纱, only a pair of deep eyes could be seen, along with that幽cold temperament not belonging to the Tianqing Sect. This aura, he had seen in a late night prophecy fragment from the Tianji Record.

choice.prompt: The mysterious woman took the initiative to make contact. Is she friend or foe? How to respond to this sudden overture?

choices.text: Accept the invitation, hear what she has to say
choices.description: Follow the mysterious woman to a secluded place, see what she's really up to
choices.visible_cost: Might fall into an unknown trap
choices.visible_reward: Might gain important intelligence or ally
choices.risk_hint: The other party's origins are unclear, there may be a conspiracy

text.content: Chen Ji nodded, following the woman to the bamboo grove behind the Martial Arena. After no one was in sight, the woman suddenly turned around, a complex light flickering in her eyes.

dialogue.content: "Young Master Chen, you should know what my identity is."

choices.description: Don't easily go with her, first use words to probe the other party's intentions
choices.visible_cost: Might miss the opportunity to proactively obtain intelligence
choices.risk_hint: The other party might lose patience

text.content: Chen Ji's footsteps did not move, merely tilting his head slightly: "Miss must be mistaken. This one is merely a servant disciple, unfamiliar with the miss." The woman's smile deepened.

dialogue.content: "Servant disciple? Hmph, was it also a'servant' from your esteemed sect who shattered Brother Zhao Yuan's three ribs with three palms?"

choices.description: Ignore the mysterious woman, continue maintaining the low-profile persona
choices.risk_hint: The other party likely won't make a second主动接触

text.content: Chen Ji clasped his hands and said: "Miss flatters me. This one must return to report. Farewell." After speaking, he turned to leave. The woman's voice came from behind, carrying a meaningful tone.

dialogue.content: "Young Master Chen, we shall meet again."

text.content: Regardless of Chen Ji's choice, the woman would ultimately hand over that note. She took out a yellowed sheet of paper from her sleeve, with only a line of elegant small characters. The moment Chen Ji took the note, the woman had already vanished like a ghost deep in the bamboo grove, leaving only a faint trace of幽fragrance.

The handwriting on the note came into view—"The Third Elder has problems." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The Third Elder? That old man who gave him an inexplicable smile at the initiation ceremony? He subconsciously tucked the note into his sleeve, and on the chessboard in his heart, several new pieces had been added.

dialogue.content: "Interesting... The Demonic Path Saint，主动 offering friendship, and delivering such intelligence. What does she want?"

text.content: Deep in the bamboo grove, Ye Qing gazed at Chen Ji's retreating figure, the corner of her lips curving into a complex arc. "Tianji Record... It's indeed on you." She murmured softly, "Chen Ji ah Chen Ji, do you know, what you carry is something even heaven's Dao must regard with wariness..." Wind passed through the bamboo grove, rustling, as if responding to her sigh. At the distant tower above, that苍老 gaze never shifted away.

The commotion at the Martial Arena gradually dispersed. The news of Chen Ji's three consecutive victories spread like wildfire throughout the Outer Sect of Tianqing Sect.
